adaptations.description: Scenario-authored oriented rectangular minefields; exact path clipping accumulates only distance inside danger area, excluding authored safe channels. No bathymetry inferred.
After sweep multiplication, round probability to nearest integer percent as the printed 0.32×0.40=0.13 example. No interpolation between spacing columns.
Explicit maximum 75% reduction takes precedence over influence generation1 pass5 table0.20; preserve raw cell but cap applied remaining at0.25.
Source rate of roughly5kt for submerged minelaying implemented as maximum5kt; mobile mines exempt. Authored source capability still mandatory.
Mine activation timers and ship counters must be explicit scenario inputs; timers never guessed.

See lifecycle: complete one-row atomic cohorts after real track/work; own event180s combat window; known individual neutralization preserves original die/claim and suspends work. Partial minefield damage explicitly pending, not inferred.

blocked.reason: First paragraph permits IntI-case antenna atP/S; last paragraph excludes IntI. IntI surface/P/S antenna branch blocked.
Only Shallow and IntI arming delays printed; other case bands need source scenario override, no guess.
Odd aircraft count gives half an attack; no rounding printed. Reject odd aircraft count unless explicit scenario adaptation.
Full vs Severe selection procedure not printed; unknown branch pending.

lifecycle.initial_contact_authority: Trusted scenario/referee authored previously-classified receipts only. Engine search/classification not implemented. No player truth-ID command bypass.
lifecycle.row_policy: First dynamic package accepts exactly one complete regular bottom-mine row no larger than the source per180s quota. Real path must intersect every declared row position. Ship cohort releases atomically after180 actual legal work seconds; sub cohort after actual route with each declared same physical loaded tube available. Each body preserves actual cohort release/arming clocks. Larger/partial rows, air/mobile fields, counters and mixed rows remain blocked.
lifecycle.combat_policy: Own real combat events mark the source180s work window. Any combat in a ship cohort halves that cohort capacity; no silent upgrade aftercombat. A row exceeding the reduced quota remains blocked until cancelled/replanned. No hidden enemy inventory/location eligibility predicate.
lifecycle.hunt_policy: One original D6 per classified mine, one neutralizer charge. Active work D6*1800sec. Combat/nonpermissive/range/depth/speed violation suspends work. Cancel pauses while preserving exclusive claim/die/progress/cost; same actor resumes. No cooperative speed-up. Source method/range/depth/work-speed/charges explicitly authored, no generic ROV defaults.
lifecycle.partial_manifest_policy: After any individual neutralization, remaining original Field and complete manifest stay saved. Actual danger-area crossings are saved as referee pending paths; do not roll old full-density Ph, reduce proportionally, declare clear, or apply sweep25% floor. Retire Field only when every manifest body actually neutralized.
lifecycle.equipment_limit: Specific neutralizer/rail functional damage mapping still requires source equipment integration; generic ship sensor capability never grants MCM fit.
lifecycle.initialization_policy: Each authored stock/fit/plan binds one unique unit name; planned/initial field identities unique. Complete manifest bodies match Field type/depth/owner/arming/activation clocks. First subset rejects trusted scenarios that give both sides classified permission to the same physical mine: contested work has no private claim procedure yet.
lifecycle.private_physical_work: Order admission/range/depth use own source report only. Actual neutralizer work also requires reaching real body inside source physical range/depth. Own task projection shows attempted_s and own-condition phase, never referee worked_s or hidden physical failure cause. Successful real operation is the completion confirmation. Report mismatch cannot authorize remote neutralization or form an immediate progress/admission probe.
lifecycle.own_plan_discovery: own_view.lay_plans lists only source-valid own-unit plans with id/actor/source/geometry and known mine/depth/spacing/timing, so player/AI does not guess plan IDs. No enemy plan or body/manifest IDs.
